title: Presentation environment on the demo laptop
scope: Make the RSL presentation runnable on the demo laptop: Frappe, Jube and the AI runtime live (ADR-031 hosted models with local/template fallback); Docling, OpenAleph and yente run beforehand with their results recorded and clearly labelled as recorded; one start command, a combined health page, restricted access and up-to-date service status docs

acceptance.text: A demo profile that fits the laptop's memory (live: Frappe, Jube, AI runtime with ADR-031 hosted models and an optional local fallback model; recorded: Docling, OpenAleph, yente outputs captured from real runs with provenance), one start/stop command, a combined health/status page, loopback-only or authenticated access, and integration/services.json plus docs/SETUP_STATUS.md updated to reality

A rehearsal from a cold start reaches a healthy demo in a measured time without manual fixes; every screen discloses live versus recorded data; memory use is measured and stays within the laptop's limit

Model keys are set only in the demo laptop's ignored .env (Groq org with Zero Data Retention enabled); observed rate limits are recorded; the demo still completes, visibly labelled, on the local or template fallback when offline or rate-limited
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

Distinguish reduced recorded-data demo from full pilot profile; for full native-UI acceptance supply reachable authorized Jube and OpenAleph interfaces on measured suitable local or remote hardware. Recorded outputs alone do not satisfy native search/graph acceptance.

verification: A rehearsal from a cold start reaches a healthy demo in a measured time without manual fixes; every screen discloses live versus recorded data; memory use is measured and stays within the laptop's limit

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 after a runtime gap analysis for the RSL demo: the component code existed but this link was not wired at runtime and no task covered it.
2026-11-05 (ADR-031): added model key, quota and fallback handling for the presentation.
2026-11-05: aligned with ADR-031 as approved by Keletso (hosted primary, local optional fallback).

notes: TAX-105 scope clarification: Preserve reduced laptop option but do not represent recorded OpenAleph output as interactive native UI readiness.
